name: ana
description: ANA — Agent-Native Agent. Attach a watch-a-dashboard + talk-to-a-coding-agent runtime to any web app, or run the standalone base. A coding agent runs inside tmux; chat is injected via paste-buffer and the session is mirrored via capture-pane — zero dependencies (no MCP, no bridge, no hooks). The whole runtime is one file, channel-core.js. Use to add ANA to an existing service or scaffold a new agent-native app.
